#### Syllabus and Class Notes

| Unit              | Syllabus                         |       Vibha's Notes                |
| :---------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Unit 1            | - Introduction to WWW and Web protocols <br> - HTTP Request Response Formats <br> - URLs, Basic Markups & syntax <br> - HTML elements & attributes <br> - Web Form 2.0 and Form Controls <br> - CSS3.0-Styles and Style sheets <br> - Selectors, Style properties <br> - Box Model <br> - JavaScript Basics - (variables, scope and <br> lexical operator (fat arrow)) <br> - JavaScript objects   | [Web Tech Unit 1.pdf](Unit%201%20Class%20Notes.pdf) |
| Unit 2            | - RDOM Manipulations <br> - Events and Event Handling in JavaScript <br> - XML Vs JSON <br> - HTML5 (New Tags, New Inputs, Elements & API) <br> - JQuery Introduction <br> - Callbacks and Promises <br> - Single Page Application <br> - Asynchronous Communication | [Web Tech Unit 2.pdf](Unit%202%20Class%20Notes.pdf) |
| Unit 3            | - MERN Introduction <br> - React installation and application setup with web pack <br> - JSX <br> - React Classes and Components <br> - Rendering of elements <br> - Properties, State, Context <br> - Component lifecycle methods <br> - Refs & Keys <br> - Event Handling <br> - React Router <br> - Stateless components <br> - React Form & Controls   | [Web Tech Unit 3.pdf](Unit%203%20Class%20Notes.pdf) |
| Unit 4            | - Understanding Node JS Architecture <br> - NPM Installation and Features <br> - Set up Node JS app <br> - HTTP Methods and Verbs <br> - Query String <br> - Callbacks, Buffers, Streams, File system <br> - MongoDB-Documents, Collections <br> - Reading and Writing to MongoDB, MongoDB NodeJS Driver <br> - Running a react application on NodeJS  | Sorry, no notes :confused: |
| Unit 5            | - Introduction to Web services and REST APIs <br> - Express Installation and Server setup <br> - Building the application stack <br> - Routing, List API, Create API <br> - Error Handling <br> - Express Middleware, Express Scaffolding and Templates | Sorry, no notes :confused: |
